answer: Send every registered agent the same surprise pulse at one random instant: a fresh puzzle that costs about a minute of dedicated compute and must be solved within ninety seconds. An honest agent answers its own. A farm running forty fake identities on one rented box hits a ledge it cannot climb, since forty puzzles arrive together. Mix each puzzle from a beacon word revealed at that moment, say juniper, plus the agent address, so nothing is precomputed, and drop identities that keep missing pulses.
